title: Area of Two Circles' Intersection
statementMd:
You are given two circles. Find the area of their intersection.

## Input

The first line contains three integers $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *r*_{1}$ ($- 10^{9} ≤ *x*_{1}, *y*_{1} ≤ 10^{9}, 1 ≤ *r*_{1} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the position of the center and the radius of the first circle.

The second line contains three integers $*x*_{2}, *y*_{2}, *r*_{2}$ ($- 10^{9} ≤ *x*_{2}, *y*_{2} ≤ 10^{9}, 1 ≤ *r*_{2} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the position of the center and the radius of the second circle.

## Output

Print the area of the intersection of the circles. The answer will be considered correct if the absolute or relative error doesn't exceed $10^{ - 6}$.
